title: KARI static-originator silently returns Ok(None) — wrong key returns same result as no-match
description: try_decrypt_kari() returns Ok(None) for any KARI with a non-ephemeral originator (IssuerAndSerialNumber or SubjectKeyIdentifier). If the recipient's key DOES match a recipient_enc_key entry within such a KARI, the function still returns Ok(None) because the originator-key check happens first and returns early. The caller then falls through to SmimeError::NoMatchingRecipient. This silently ignores static-originator KARIs entirely, even when the recipient key matches. The comment says 'require a different key-lookup path' but that path is never taken — the key match never even happens.
